company.shortDescription: Mystic is a provider of infrastructure-as-a-service for data engineers and software developers.
company.description: Mystic is a provider of infrastructure-as-a-service for data engineers and software developers. It also provides tools and models that enable its customers to deliver robust, dynamic machine learning in an agile manner. Their customers' inquiries are addressed through phone, email, and online applications. Mystic aims to provide data scientists and ML organizations with the engineering tools they need to build end-to-end products faster, with the goal of demystifying how to build scalable ML products.
company.headquarters: Bath, Bath and North East Somerset, United Kingdom
